name: Cebu Marathon 2027
short_description: The Cebu Marathon 2027 is a full marathon (plus half, 10K, and 5K options) held in Cebu City, Philippines on January 10, 2027.
ai_summary: The Cebu Marathon 2027 is scheduled for January 10, 2027, in Cebu City, Philippines, organized by Cebu Marathon. The event offers four distance options: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race, catering to a range of runner abilities. Runners interested in participating should watch for official updates regarding sign-up details.

faqs.question: When is the Cebu Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: The Cebu Marathon 2027 is scheduled to take place on January 10, 2027. The race will be held in Cebu City, Philippines, and is organized by Cebu Marathon. This date marks the specific day when all four distance events—marathon, half marathon, 10K, and 5K—will be run.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at Cebu Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Cebu Marathon 2027 offers four distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a 5 km race.
